text:
sam: quick async update — landed the microbatch slotting PR (https://git.redwood/infra/slotting/pull/421). basic bench looks promising but saw KV cache thrash under synthetic 32-concurrency load. p95 dropped from ~320ms -> ~260ms, p99 still a bit high. can someone eyeball the PR when CI finishes? :pray:

lena: nice. can you paste the exact bench command + runtime flags? want to repro locally.

sam: sure — ran on canary-n1 (A100). command:
```
./perfbench --model=redwood/llama2-13b --seq=4096 --concurrency=32 --microbatch=8 --slotting=adaptive --kv-prefetch=0.2
```
also kernel flags: `--kernels=fast-attn,v2` `--kv-slot-count=8192`

devon: KV thrash sounds like slot contention. did you see a lot of eviction spikes? can you paste the eviction rate from the canary telemetry?

sam: paste of the short log snippet from canary telemetry (last 5m):
```
[2026-03-15T14:02:10Z] evictions/sec: 24.3, hit_rate: 0.86, avg_kv_write_ms: 1.8
[2026-03-15T14:06:10Z] evictions/sec: 67.9, hit_rate: 0.71, avg_kv_write_ms: 4.2  # spike
[2026-03-15T14:08:45Z] oom_count: 0, retry_rate: 0.03
```

lena: hmm that second line is high. try bumping `--kv-slot-count` or enable `--kv-prefill=true` for the canary. prefill tends to stabilize cold-start write bursts.

kai: i can take the PR review. once CI passes (esp. integration tests for kv) ping me. also consider lowering microbatch to 6 for the canary to reduce concurrent KV pressure while we test slotting changes.

bench-bot: scheduled perf run #453 for canary-n1 with microbatch=6, kv-prefill=true. results will post here when done.

nora: small thing — noticed a 503 from the canary around 14:07 during the spike. opened a short incident (INC-3219) with logs attached. might be related to the eviction spike.

sam: ack. blocker for me is confirming whether prefill + slot_count bump fixes p99 and the 503. i'll run the bench from my laptop, then push a canary with microbatch=6 + kv-prefill and watch.

devon: if you want me to, i can patch the eviction metric dashboard to add a 1m rolling avg so spikes show more clearly — will help next time.

sam: that'd be great, ty. will post results here.

bench-bot: perf run #453 complete: p95=258ms, p99=412ms, throughput=228 req/s. kv evictions/sec avg=12.4. more detailed metrics uploaded to https://metrics.redwood/canary/453

lena: nice improvement on p95. p99 still higher but eviction avg down which is promising.

kai: reviewing PR now — leaving inline comments about a potential race in slot allocator.

sam: today — will: 1) push canary with kv-prefill + microbatch=6, 2) repro locally with smaller concurrency to iterate faster, 3) address any smaller comments from kai. blockers: need slot allocator fix if kai confirms race.

nora: FYI i'm following the incident, will update if 503 resurfaces after the canary. :eyes:

sam: thanks all. ping me if you want a quick sync.
